caption_L1: Here a is a line diagram labeled Chicken production in Malaysia from 2005 to 2018 (in million heads). The y-axis shows Production in million heads while the x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: The X-axis plotting the year increases in increments of 2. The Y-axis plotting production increases it in increments of 50 million heads. The lowest chicken production in Malaysia was in 2005 at just over 175 million heads. The highest chicken production in Malaysia was in 2018 at just under 325 million heads. There has been a steady increase in chicken production in Malaysia from 2005 to 2018.
